title: People Can Follow Your WordPress Blog Like a Social Account
content:
Did you know… 🤓

…that you can gain followers on your WordPress blog, just like you do on social media platforms?

There’s a huge network called the Fediverse. It connects independent platforms like Mastodon with one another, rather than everything being owned by a single corporation. With a free plugin, you can make your WordPress blog part of it.

That means users can follow your blog, like it, or reply to your posts. No algorithms, no ads, and your content stays yours! Why not check out the WordPress plugin “ActivityPub”?
